name: Baseball
summary: Two separate white leather figure-eight covers, narrow recessed seam, and exactly 108 V-shaped double stitches (216 separate red tube strands), with capped ends embedded into the cover. Subtle leather grain is a baked normal map.

display.origin: Actual floor contact point under the horizontally centred exported bounds

accuracy_notes: MLB Official Baseball Rules, rule 3.01: circumference 9–9.25 inches; midpoint 9.125 in = 231.775 mm, diameter 73.776 mm. The Library of Congress confirms 108 double stitches. The spherical two-lobed cover boundary is an original approximation, not a manufacturing cutting pattern. Thread cross-sections are six-sided and stylized; no interior core, individual thread fibers or stitch holes are modeled. Measured extents include raised seams/threads; nominal diameter describes the skin. Fine grain is normal detail only. Source: https://blogs.loc.gov/loc/2018/03/baseballs-the-heart-of-the-matter/
